stages.name: championship group
stages.note: Top 6; home and away against the other five.

stages.name: relegation group
stages.note: Bottom 6; home and away against the other five. 12th relegated, 11th to the play-off.

playoff.entries: 11th of the Niké liga vs 2nd of the II. Liga
playoff.note: Baráž over two legs; the winner plays in the Niké liga next season. This is the same tie as the II. Liga promotion play-off.
Plays the 11th of the Niké liga over two legs. The champion is promoted directly subject to licensing; reserve sides (Slovan B, Žilina B) cannot be promoted.

format.note: National under-19 championship of the professional clubs' youth sides; format and round count not verified.

boundaries.note: II. Liga champion up directly (subject to licence); 2nd plays the Niké liga 11th over two legs. Niké liga 12th goes down directly, 11th only through that same tie, so one place moves through it.

conflicts.detail: SK19 (I. liga staršieho dorastu, U19) has no usable public table; our 14 clubs could not be confirmed. Kept as-is and flagged rather than guessed.
The II. Liga champion is promoted only if it meets the league's requirements; a licensed lower-placed club can take the place. Promotion is not purely sporting.

notes: SLO1: 12 clubs, 22 rounds then a 6+6 split for 10 more (32 total), points carried; 12th relegated, 11th in a two-legged baráž against the II. Liga runner-up. SK2: 16 clubs, 30 rounds; champion up subject to licence, 2nd to the play-off, bottom two down to the 3. Liga (level 3, not modelled, hence closed_down=true). Reserve sides Slovan B and Žilina B cannot be promoted. SK19 is the U19 youth championship: closed both ways, no senior route, size unverified. 2026-27 started 25-26 July 2026 with a winter break 13 Dec 2026 - 7 Feb 2027.
